packageRules.description: A Python minor is breaking in practice (ABI, removed APIs, wheel availability): group the interpreter bumps (Docker images, setup-python) into one PR and never automerge it. matchPackageNames matches the packageName: setup-python's python-version is actions/python-versions (its depName is just python), and Docker images are written fully qualified. Declared after :automergeMinor so it wins.

Group the Node.js runtime (setup-node, Docker images) with @types/node so a bump lands as one PR. matchPackageNames matches the packageName: setup-node's node-version is actions/node-versions (its depName is just node). Docker images are written fully qualified, so the unqualified `node` is not listed.
